setupBurden.low: No bootstrap, external dependency, or schedule.
setupBurden.medium: One or two setup signals, without an MCP connection or native extension.
setupBurden.high: An MCP connection, native extension, or at least three setup signals.

boundaryAttention.standard: Portable workspace artifacts without an additional declared capability.
boundaryAttention.guarded: Pinned skills, guided local setup, or an explicit bounded tool policy.
boundaryAttention.heightened: Plugin runtime, native extension, network MCP, scheduled execution, or full tool profile.

rules.proofTier: Derived from the authoritative Experience case target.
